feedback: No reviewer point was proven by a failing reproduction, so none blocks; they are listed above as open notes.
unproven: missing_requirements: R9 - The training filter must remain hydrated and working. The refactored code moved the training filter component but there is no evidence in the provided files that the filter state and UI still function correctly after changes. Add tests or ensure the filter still updates the displayed courses without breaking hydration.

missing_requirements: R10 - The Menu button must remain hydrated and working. The Header component code was not inspected, but the new navigation links and mobile menu need to correctly set aria-expanded, toggle the panel, and close on link click. Ensure the implementation matches the tests for opening/closing the menu.

missing_requirements: R14 - Brand colors require specific values (deep navy #0B1F3A, teal #1F8A8A, darker navy #071528, pale teal-grey #F2F7F7, hairline #E3E8EF). The theme.css defines many colors but does not include the required --color-navy-deep, --color-surface-teal, and --color-hairline values, nor does it map them to the brand tokens used in the components. Add these missing CSS variables and ensure they are used.

missing_requirements: R17 - System monospace font should be used only for technical labels. The theme.css defines --font-mono but the components do not apply it to diagram labels, eyebrows, or deliverable names. Ensure those elements have class applying the monospace font.

missing_requirements: R18 - WCAG AA contrast must be satisfied everywhere, including text over photos and diagrams. There is no evidence that gradient overlays or text colors meet the required contrast ratios. Add CSS to enforce sufficient contrast for all overlay text.

missing_requirements: R21/R22 - Hero h1 font size must be 60-64px on desktop and 38-40px on phones. The theme.css only defines generic --text-h1 values (2.25rem) which may not meet the required pixel ranges. Adjust the CSS to enforce the correct responsive font sizes.

missing_requirements: R23/R24 - Section h2 font size must be 40-44px on desktop, 28-32px on phones. The theme.css defines --text-h2 as 1.75rem, which does not guarantee these pixel values. Update the CSS to meet the spec.

missing_requirements: R27 - Content max width must be 1200px centered. The global layout does not define a container max-width of 1200px. Add a CSS rule for the .container class to enforce max-width:1200px and centering.

missing_requirements: R28/R29 - Section padding must be 96px top/bottom on desktop and 64px on phones. The CSS does not define these explicit padding values for sections. Add appropriate padding rules.

missing_requirements: R31 - No horizontal scrolling at 390px width. The layout may cause overflow due to fixed widths (e.g., images without max-width). Ensure overflow-x:hidden and all elements are responsive.

missing_requirements: R33/R34 - Home must have at least three navy bands and never have two plain white sections of card grids in a row. The current HomePage implementation may not enforce this ordering; verify and adjust the layout order and band colors accordingly.

missing_requirements: R36/R37/R38 - Card styling (radius, border, shadow, icon tile) must follow spec. The CSS does not include explicit rules for .card with radius 12px, border 1px #E3E8EF, shadow lift on hover, and .icon-tile size. Add or adjust CSS classes to match.

The ArchitectureDiagram component was not inspected; verify it implements all label texts exactly and uses correct font and variant colors.

open_notes: Engagements page renders enterprise tier as an <article id="enterprise"> but the test suite expects the enterprise tier to be wrapped in an <article> element with id "enterprise" (see __tests__/acceptance/engagements-render.test.ts). The task specifies that the enterprise tier should be styled as a dark navy card with a teal outline and the enterprise-atrium photo, but it does not require the tier to be an <article> element; it only says the section id is "enterprise". The test's expectation for an <article> element is contradictory to the task requirements, causing a test failure. The test should be updated to accept any element with id "enterprise" (e.g., <section> or <div>) instead of strictly <article>.

The build script and prerender script refer to the built server bundle at "../dist-server/entry-server.js" and to copy the built assets. However, the actual server entry point is src/entry-server.tsx compiled to dist-server/entry-server.js, but the repository may not contain the dist-server directory at build time. This may cause a runtime error in the prerender step, which could affect the static validation test (prerendered pages). The setup should ensure that the server bundle is correctly built before running the prerender script.

R71: The architecture diagram variant usage does not implement the required color scheme for dark backgrounds – the dark variant still uses the same colors as the light variant, missing the required white and teal colors on navy backgrounds.
R104: The Home systems band link text "How we build systems" is present, but the link is not styled as a primary button as required and lacks an explicit aria-label for accessibility.

R123: The "Why The Bayes Group" section does not place the about-office photo beside the text on desktop – the photo is currently rendered within the same column, violating the requirement that the text column holds heading, paragraph and supporting elements beside a photo.

R133: On the Systems page, the four sections are not given distinct background colors alternating white and pale teal‑grey – the current CSS applies the same background to all sections, failing the alternate background requirement.
R138: The "What every system ships with" section is not rendered on a navy background – the component uses a default light background, contrary to the requirement that this section be navy.

R143: The Engagements page h1 is "Engagements" as required, but the page does not include a distinct heading level for the "Not sure which fits?" line, making it ambiguous for screen readers; it should be wrapped in a heading element (e.g., h2) to satisfy accessibility expectations.
R151: The Enterprise tier card does not apply the required teal outline style – the CSS class "premium" only adds a label and background but lacks the teal outline border.
R155: The Enterprise tier CTA button label is "Talk to us about enterprise" but should be a primary button style similar to other tiers and include the correct ARIA role.

R192 & R193: The prerender script does not actually generate prerendered HTML files for /systems and /engagements – only the existing pages are prerendered, causing missing static files for the new routes.
R194: The public/sitemap.xml still lists only five pages; it does not include the newly added /systems and /engagements entries.
